title: Unbrewed dylibs in `/usr/local/lib` stay
resolution: `pkgutil` names the owners — `libEioPal`, `libTCMsgSrv2` and `libTCMsgSvr2` belong to `com.tcelectronic.pkg.TCAudioInterfaceSoftware` (the audio interface driver), `libcpsrt` to `com.wibu.cmdriver` (CodeMeter licensing), and `libext2fs` to an ext2/3/4 filesystem installer. Homebrew only warns because it did not put them there; deleting them breaks audio hardware and licence dongles.
